title: Pirate's Cove
short_description: A live open-ocean pirate sandbox — sail freely, raid patrolling ships in real-time dice combat, and dock at explorable islands for treasure, away-team fights, and crew.
description: Pirate's Cove is a real-time 3D open-sea sandbox. You sail a ship across a vast reflective ocean — throttle and rudder, a chase camera at your stern — while NPC ships patrol and wander the waves. Some are pirates and marauders who will hunt you; combat is LIVE (not turn-based) and resolves on d20 to-hit rolls, damage bands and critical hits. Scattered across the sea are dozens of little islands: sail close and dock to find buried treasure, fight pirates ashore, drive off marauders, or rescue castaways who join your crew.
controls_keyboard: W/S throttle · A/D steer · SPACE fire broadside · E dock · ashore: WASD move, SPACE blade/🏹 bow, E back to ship
